SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.ID LINKROWID ,S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCLIN ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,S.ITMVER ,S.QTYSTU ,S.STU ,S.QTY ,S.UOM ,S.UOMCOE ,S.REMARK LREMARK ,S.PRJNUM LPRJNUM ,S.CLOREA LCLOREA ,SUBSTA.OPTDES SUBSTA ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[SUBTIM], 21) SUBTIM ,S.BATCHID ,S.SRCTYP ,S.SRCDOC ,S.SRCLIN ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTA ,S.CREUSR ,S.UPDUSR ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[UPDTIM], 21) UPDTIM ,IIF(S.DOCSTA = '1', '', '1') LDEBFLG ,IIF(S.DOCSTA = '1', '', '1') LCLBFLG FROM PRETLIN S INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT SUBSTA ON SUBSTA.OPTID = S.SUBSTA AND SUBSTA.OPTTYP = 'SUBSTA' WHERE S.DOCNUM = '{0}'
